author: Praxis I
title: Idea 4b — QMAP-quantiles (λ=0.8): Blended Global Quantile Mapping + ComBat → PCA50 → kNN15
abstract: Same corrected QMAP but blended (λ=0.8) to reduce over-alignment risk; then ComBat → PCA(50) → kNN(15, cosine).

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from scipy import sparse as sp
from praxis.simple_batch_transforms import apply_qmap_global_inplace

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    n_pcs = 50
    n_neighbors = 15
    metric = 'cosine'

    assert 'batch' in adata.obs.columns and 'feature_name' in adata.var.columns
    batches = np.asarray(adata.obs['batch'].astype('category').values)

    if 'counts' in adata.layers:
        adata.X = adata.layers['counts'].copy()
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)

    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor='seurat_v3', batch_key='batch', n_top_genes=2000, inplace=True)
    hv = adata.var['highly_variable'].to_numpy()

    Xd = adata.X.A if sp.issparse(adata.X) else adata.X
    apply_qmap_global_inplace(Xd, batches=batches, gene_mask=hv, lam=0.8)
    adata.X = Xd

    sc.pp.combat(adata, key='batch')
    sc.pp.pca(adata, n_comps=n_pcs, use_highly_variable=True, svd_solver='arpack', random_state=0)
    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = adata.obsm['X_pca']
    sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep='X_emb', n_neighbors=n_neighbors, metric=metric)
    return adata
